summary: South edge of the dead-end turning head, backing onto bush, homes over 20 m.
reasons: Bush and a footpath on the south side
Nearest mapped dwelling over 20 m from start

best_section.where: South kerb at the end of the road, beside the bushland and path

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush to the west and south-west; mapped houses are 12 m (at 21 m) and 19 m away, further from the first 14 m, with the north side across the wide turning head.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed turning head; the ground beside the lane at the start is wide enough to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end residential street; only local traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park in the turning head and a truck sits at the kerb; no campers seen.

flags: Two No Stopping Any Time signs sit 7-14 m from the kerb line, so check the arrows on site
Steep: about 5% mean grade over the stretch (24% max is likely a DEM artefact), about 3% near the start
Witton Creek mapped about 3 m away, min elevation 38 m
sun_shade: Bush shades the west side in the afternoon; open to morning sun.
cannot_judge: Which kerb the No Stopping signs cover
